pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions (pyramiding) into an ongoing directional wick; subsequent entries require at least a 15-pip pullback and established 5-minute consolidation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based volatility filter and order-book spread check; no trades allowed within 5 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic print windows or when spread exceeds 3.0 pips on XAUUSD.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops or partial profit locks the exact moment open positions reach +$10.00 to guarantee net-positive outcomes toward the $15-$30 target range.
